summary: Shaw pressed for stronger enforcement of AB 715, California's antisemitism-in-schools bill, at a state-superintendent forum, criticizing a rival's abstention and accusing another of weakening the resolution. In March 2024, as Chino Valley Unified School Board President, she refused to let a pro-Palestinian group address the board while other boards passed ceasefire resolutions. A December 2023 Fox News appearance framed the Gaza conflict around 'growing antisemitism in young people.' Vote for Peace opposed her in the general election.
